_comment: Settings for crewctl. plan is "free" or "paid". On "free", crewctl refuses models that need a paid Kiro plan, and uses each agent's "model". On "paid", it uses "paid_model" where an agent sets one. Change this one word when you move to a machine with a paid plan. Leave agents_dir and crew_home out to use ~/.kiro/agents and ~/.kiro/crew on the machine where this runs.
_skills_comment: Optional. skills_dir: where skills with destination "crew" are written (default <crew home>/skills). project_skills_dir: where destination "project" skills go, for example "../.kiro/skills" (relative to this folder).
